issues.problem: act value 何も買いに行けませんでした ('couldn't go and buy anything') is awkward Japanese; a native speaker would say 買い物にも行けませんでした.
issues.action: Replaced with {何[なに]も|ko-mo}することがありませんでした / 'there was nothing to do', which fits every weather reason and keeps 7 values.
